> Hi Requester
>
> I have checked with the Glamorgan Archives to see what districts would
> have come under South Glamorgan in 1983 and they give me Bridgend.
> Pontypridd and Merthyr Tydfil. I have checked with all these districts and
> they do not hold a death record for Mary Doreen Williams in the March qtr
> of 1983. I have also checked with Thornhill Crematorium to see if they had
> a burial or cremation record here in Cardiff and they don’t hold any record
> either. They also checked Glyntaff Crematorium and Coychurch Crematorium
> and they don’t hold any record of the burial or cremation there either. As
> previously discussed with you if you quote VOLUME 28 PAGE NO 3029 to our
> head office they will do a copy of the certificate from there for you.
> Their contact telephone number is [phone redacted] or alternatively you can
> email Order a birth, death, marriage or civil partnership certificate -
> GOV.UK  .
> There is nothing more that I can do for you with this request as we do not
> hold the record here in Cardiff. I am sorry that I cannot be of more help
> to you and good luck in your search.
>
>
>
> Kind Regards

> Karen

> Dear Ms Denham,
>
> Mary Doreen Williams: death registration
>
> On 30 September 2026 the Vale of Glamorgan Registration Service told me
> they could not find a death record for Mary Doreen Williams in the Vale,
> and that they had passed my request to Cardiff. I have not had a reply from
> Cardiff.
>
> Please could you:
>
> 1. confirm whether Cardiff Register Office holds a registration of death
> for Mary Doreen Williams;
> 2. if it does, tell me how I can obtain a certified copy and the fee; and
> 3. if it does not, tell me which indexes and registers were searched, so
> that I can search the GRO death index for the correct registration district.
>
> If you need further details to carry out the search (approximate date or
> place of death, date of birth, last address), please tell me what you need
> and I will supply it. I am asking as a family member and I need the
> registration for estate administration.
>
> Thank you for your help.
>
> Regards,
>
> Requester
